11 Essential Web Tools in One Bookmark

Dark mode, enable copy, QR codes, translation, web converters, and more. All your favorite browser tools in one place.

Install Web Tools

11 Tools, Endless Possibilities

  • 🌙 Dark Mode: Enable dark mode on any website
  • 📋 Enable Copy: Remove copy restrictions from websites
  • 🔍 Highlight Structure: Visualize HTML element structure
  • 📷 Image Downloader: Extract high-resolution images
  • 📱 QR Code Generator: Create QR codes for any page
  • ⏮️ Wayback Machine: View pages in Internet Archive
  • 📄 Save as PDF: Save webpages as searchable PDF documents
  • 🖼️ Save as Image: Capture full-page screenshots as PNG images
  • 📝 Save as Word: Convert webpages to editable Word documents
  • 📋 Save as Markdown: Extract clean Markdown from any article
  • 📃 Save as Text: Get distraction-free text from any webpage

Perfect For

📱 Mobile Users

Enable dark mode and copy on any site, even sites that block these features.

🌍 Multilingual Users

Instant translation to any language without leaving the page.

🔬 Researchers

Download images, generate QR codes, analyze page structure, and save articles in multiple formats.

🎨 Content Creators

Extract images, copy restricted content, share pages via QR codes, and convert web content to various formats.

📚 Students & Professionals

Save webpages as PDF, images, or documents for offline reading, archiving, and citation.

3-Second Install, Use Forever

1

Press and Hold Button

Click and hold the purple 'Web Tools' button.

2

Drag to Bookmarks Bar

Web Tools

Crucial Step: Drag the button to your browser's 'Bookmarks Bar' or 'Favorites Bar', then release the mouse.

3

Done! Click to Open

On any page, click this bookmark to access all 11 tools.
